incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: capacity.exhaustion - inference-cell-eu-west-1
pagerduty: Incident 98765 triggered; urgency: high; route: eng-oncall
alex: Acked. I'm looking.
maria: Noted, I'll grab metrics and check autoscaler. @alex what's the current queue size? :eyes:
oncall-sre: Queue backlog ~18k requests, p99 latency 4.2s, ~5% 500s. Autoscaler desired replicas 12, actual 6. HPA cpuMetric appears stale (kube-metrics lag).
alex: Can we manual-scale short term? kubectl scale deployment/inference-worker --replicas=24
ops-lead: +1 to manual scale but watch spot eviction. Also enable aggressive warmup: set rollout param inference/kv-warmup=on
maria: Running scale now, 6 -> 24
maria: kubectl output: deployment.apps/inference-worker scaled
oncall-sre: New pods arriving but warmup delay ~45s per pod before KV cache populated. Prefix misses causing CPU spike and some 502s during cold starts.
alex: If HPA isn't reacting to queue depth we should add queue-length metric. Applying quick patch to HPA to include queueLength.
maria: Patch applied. HPA will consider queue depth in addition to CPU. Monitoring for 5m.
oncall-sre: Customer impact: several EU-hosted tenants seeing degraded throughput and transient 502/504. No data loss reported. Flagging product for communications.
ops-lead: Also paging eng-sre to check cloud quotas; aggressive scaling may hit vCPU quota in eu-west-1.
eng-sre-steven: On it. Quota increase requested via cloud console, ETA 20-40m. Meanwhile enable reserved-pool burst fallback.
alex: Enabled burst capacity fallback for affected accounts.
maria: Queue length trending down from 18k -> 3k after scale + warmup. p99 latency down to ~600ms.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: 98765 acknowledged by alex
pagerduty: Reminder: if unresolved in 15m escalate to eng-sre-lead
oncall-sre: Stabilizing but root cause looks like autoscaler metric source regression (metrics-server -> HPA lag). Filing bug: AUTOSCALER-487 and attaching graphs.
ops-lead: Handoff to night oncall in 30m: @nora please take post-incident monitoring and follow up with eng-reliability on quota and HPA change validation.
nora: Ack, I'll take it and watch for any re-regen. Will coordinate postmortem and customer comms.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: 98765 resolved — condition cleared at 6298766632
alex: Thanks all. Action items: 1) postmortem with timeline + HPA/metrics graphs 2) rollout queue-based HPA in canary 3) increase warmup parallelism and cache prefetching 4) follow up on quota request. :white_check_mark:
